meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 可根据对话要求，给出用 VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等屏幕阅读器测试网页的可操作步骤，包括各读屏命令、测试脚本与检查清单，以及修复常见无障碍问题的 HTML 示例。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证网页的屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试辅助技术问题，或确保无障碍支持时触发。

say.text: 用 VoiceOver 检查我的网页标题层级和导航是否正常。
say.note: 会给出对应命令与检查清单。

say.text: NVDA 读不了动态加载的提示，怎么修复？
say.note: 提供 aria-live 等代码修复示例。

say.text: 帮我按 JAWS 测试脚本走一遍表单提交流程。
say.note: 逐项验证并指出可访问性问题。

howto.what_en: On request, it provides actionable steps for testing web pages with VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS, and other screen readers—including commands, test scripts, checklists, and HTML fixes for common accessibility issues.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask Claude to validate screen reader compatibility, debug accessibility issues, or ensure assistive technology support.

say_en.text: Use VoiceOver to check my page's heading levels and navigation.
say_en.note: Provides the VoiceOver commands and checklist.

say_en.text: NVDA doesn't announce dynamically loaded content — how do I fix it?
Walk me through the JAWS test script for form submission.
say_en.note: Checks each step and flags issues.
